current_sources.fuse_bank: Retain R47 design; new placement/mounting qualification OPEN

mount_methods.boards: Screws and insulating spacers at actual board holes; retain known mounts; no unsupported/glued hot boards
mount_methods.distribution: Separate screw-mounted PETG tie rails; each installed WAGO/oprawka mechanically retained; no complete-cassette removal requirement
mount_methods.battery: Retained supported P0 tray and two straps; shell is not battery support
mount_methods.wires: Shared bundles tied on intact insulation, edge sleeves and free slack at moving joints; solder is not a load path
mount_methods.repair: Power off; allow neighbouring module removal and replacement of ties; no independent 74-wire disconnect requirement
mount_methods.source: Retain F0/S0/manual S1 and short protected branch rules; missing E3 data not waived

corridor_policy: Planning spine plus endpoint tails; not complete routes. Upper bundles may exceed cosmetic roof for open trials. Move/cut ties for fuse service; no sealed-shell qualification.
assembly_order: P0 frame/legs and retained battery support; keep both sides accessible
Bench solder and insulate MAIN; neck risers and MAIN before S0
Pi/BUS/logic boards on actual-hole spacers, then source switches/fuse assemblies
Distribution and R47 bank retained with simple tie rails; wire before obstructing neighbour modules
Complete marked bundles, strain relief and motion slack, then head/tail assemblies
Local underside/terminal guards; leave upper cosmetic torso shell off
Phase2 dry-fit, trim and electrical checks before any power or movement
next_gate: One shared set of screw-mounted tie rails/board supports; verify affected bays incl F_PI solder branch and all MAIN exits before print selection
